title: About The Seat Keeps Thinking
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @manta_timing: TOMORROW - 9am PST “The Thinker” 1/1 auction with redeemable print 0.75 SOL r.... Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Seat Keeps Thinking: Early-2000s render dreamworld: a flat lemon-yellow wall meets pixel-mottled green turf along a low horizon across a wide landscape plate. Frontal locked-off camera, offset empty-pedestal archetype: a lone lavender cube on thin pale legs sits left of center, its jagged stair-stepped top edge carrying the source, empty. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to Jagged stair-stepped top edge of the empty lavender cube seat.
